CVE-2010-2891.title: Buffer overflow in the smiGetNode function in lib/smi.c in libsmi ...
CVE-2010-2891.description: Buffer overflow in the smiGetNode function in lib/smi.c in libsmi 0.4.8 allows context-dependent attackers to execute arbitrary code via an Object Identifier (aka OID) represented as a numerical string containing many components separated by . (dot) characters.

CVE-2026-111137.title: libsmi through 0.5.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerabilit ...
CVE-2026-111137.description: libsmi through 0.5.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in smiValueAsString() in lib/smi.c that allows attackers to overflow a fixed 1024-byte static buffer through hex rendering of OCTET STRING values. Attackers can supply a crafted MIB with an OCTET STRING DEFVAL of 512 or more octets and a leading 0x00 byte to corrupt adjacent library globals and crash smidump or other consumers.
